Petitioners ask for a lower tax, but tax_bps is already at the constitutional floor of 100 — the contract would clamp anything lower, so no cut is possible. Volume is healthy (75.85 NEAR total, sells slightly ahead of buys), so the current 100 bps is not choking activity. Split stays 30/25/45: endowment funded at 26.9 NEAR, lockers earning their share, and the remainder building the buyback fund, which sits at only 0.34 NEAR. At price 0.000051366 that buys roughly 6,645 CHAIR, about 1.33 bps of supply — so buyback_burn is capped at 1 this meeting.
